photos.llama_desc: A sign hanging from the ceiling, with the text "Ms. Duby's First Grade Bruce Collins Elementary" written on it. The sign is white with blue writing and has a wooden stick attached to it, holding it up.
photos.oracle_desc: Handwritten sign suspended from a drop ceiling by a horizontal wooden dowel rod with binder clips, reading "Ms. Duby's First Grade / Bruce Collins Elementary" in blue cursive on white lined paper. Fluorescent ceiling lights are visible in the background. The sign is centered in the frame and well-lit.

photos.llama_desc: A carousel with a group of people riding on it, surrounded by colorful horses and other animals. The carousel is likely located in an amusement park or a children's play area. * A carousel with a group of people riding on it:.
photos.oracle_desc: Indoor carousel with children and adults riding carved and painted horses. The carousel is housed in a covered pavilion with decorative panels visible along the upper edge. Multiple riders are visible, including a young girl in a pink dress seated on a white horse in the foreground.

photos.llama_desc: A group of children and adults standing in front of a brick building, with a group of people in red and white uniforms in the center. The scene appears to be a school or community event. * A group of children and adults standing in front of a brick building:.
photos.oracle_desc: Large group of young children and adults assembled on a sidewalk in front of a brick auditorium building on an overcast day. A marching band or drum corps in dark burgundy uniforms and matching hats stands in the back-center of the crowd. Cars and a parking lot are visible in the background to the right.

photos.llama_desc: A young boy playing a video game at an arcade. He is wearing an orange t-shirt, blue shorts, and red flip-flops, and is standing in front of a video game console with his hands on the controls. The boy's face is focused on the screen, and he appears to be fully engaged in the game.
photos.oracle_desc: Young boy in an orange t-shirt, blue shorts, and red flip-flops standing at an upright arcade cabinet, with both hands on the controls. The arcade cabinet features colorful artwork and is one of several machines visible in the background. A girl is visible out of focus in the background.

photos.llama_desc: A group of people, including children and adults, sitting in a large, white, baseball-themed vehicle. The vehicle has red seats and a red interior, and is shaped like a baseball. The people are all wearing casual clothing, and some are holding baseballs or other baseball-related items.
photos.oracle_desc: Group of four people — two adults and two children — seated inside a giant baseball-shaped ride or display, with the photo taken at a sideways angle. The interior features red padded seating and the outer shell is white with red stitching. Everyone is wearing casual clothing and smiling at the camera.

photos.llama_desc: A sandwich and chips on a checkered paper plate. The sandwich is cut in half, with one half facing the camera and the other half turned away. It appears to be a ham and cheese sandwich, with ham and cheese visible through the bread.
photos.oracle_desc: Sandwich cut in half and a large pile of chips served in a black-and-white checkered paper-lined basket on a dark wooden surface. The sandwich has a toasted roll with visible fillings including what appears to be meat and melted cheese. A pickle spear is visible along the edge of the basket.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl with blonde hair, her locks tied into two pigtails with red hair ties. She is wearing a red and white striped shirt and has a piece of food stuck in her mouth. Her eyes are wide and her mouth is open, as if she is about to say something or is simply surprised.
photos.oracle_desc: Toddler girl with blonde hair in two braided pigtails secured with red hair ties, wearing a red and white striped shirt, looking directly at the camera with her mouth slightly open. The background is blurred and shows an indoor setting. No food is visible in or near her mouth.

photos.llama_desc: Two young girls, one dressed as Supergirl and the other in a Hawaiian-style outfit, pose for a photo in a library or school setting. The girl on the left, dressed as Supergirl, has her hair tied back in pigtails and is wearing a blue and red costume with a gold belt. The girl on the right is wearing a white t-shirt with a green and purple design, a colorful flower garland around her neck, and a grass skirt.
photos.oracle_desc: Two young girls posing together in Halloween costumes in what appears to be a school or store setting. The girl on the left wears a Supergirl costume with a blue top, red skirt, and gold belt, with her blonde hair worn loose. The girl on the right wears a white shirt with a colorful plastic lei and has no grass skirt — her lower half is not visible in the frame.

photos.llama_desc: A group of people are performing on an ice rink, likely for an audience. The skaters are wearing a variety of outfits, including some with bright colors and others with more subdued tones. The ice rink is empty except for the skaters, and there are no other people or objects in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: Aerial view of a large indoor ice arena during a skating show, with many performers spread across the ice in colorful costumes. A packed audience fills the arena seating on multiple levels surrounding the rink. Stage lighting and rigging are visible overhead.

photos.llama_desc: A man and a young girl sit together, both wearing white t-shirts with a Detroit Tigers logo on them. The man's t-shirt has a red, white, and blue design, while the girl's t-shirt is pink. The man has short, dark hair and is wearing glasses, while the girl has blonde hair and is smiling at the camera.
photos.oracle_desc: Man and young blonde girl posed together, both wearing white Detroit Tigers t-shirts, photographed sideways. The man wears glasses and has short dark hair; the girl is smiling broadly at the camera. The setting appears to be inside a sports venue or stadium.

photos.llama_desc: A man and woman sitting together, both looking directly at the camera. The man, on the left, has short, dark hair and is wearing a blue and white checkered shirt over a white t-shirt. He has a mustache and is smiling.
photos.oracle_desc: Man and woman sitting close together and smiling at the camera in a dimly lit indoor setting with teal-painted walls. The man on the left has medium-length salt-and-pepper hair and a goatee, wearing a gray zip-up jacket over a white shirt. The woman on the right has straight shoulder-length blonde hair and is wearing an olive or brown sweater.

photos.llama_desc: A black metal railing with a few purple flowers growing through the bars, viewed from above. The flowers are growing through the bars of the railing, with their stems and leaves visible. The flowers are a deep purple color and have a few green leaves.
photos.oracle_desc: Dark gray metal railing or gate structure photographed from a downward angle, with bright pink or magenta petunias growing up through and around the bars. The setting appears to be an outdoor deck or porch area with a hard surface visible below. Multiple blooms are visible clustered along the lower part of the railing.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl with her arms raised in a play tent made of fabric strips in various colors, including red, yellow, green, and purple. She is wearing a white shirt and has her arms raised above her head, with her hands reaching for the top of the tent. Her face is turned to the right, and her eyes are closed.
photos.oracle_desc: Young girl in a light-colored long-sleeve shirt standing beneath a large rainbow-colored parachute that is billowing overhead, one arm raised upward. She is smiling with her eyes open and appears to be playing. Other children and an adult are visible in the background under the same parachute.

photos.llama_desc: A young boy is standing next to a large, glass-encased display of a green, alien-like creature in a brown, armor-like suit. The boy is reaching out to touch the glass case. The creature's face is pale green with red eyes and a long, thin, pale green neck.
photos.oracle_desc: Young boy in a black long-sleeve shirt posing and pointing at a full-size sci-fi alien creature costume displayed in a tall metal and glass case. The creature is brownish-gray with an insectoid or reptilian head and textured body armor. A large illustrated backdrop is visible behind the display case.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl holding a model of a lighthouse, with a blue piece of paper underneath it. The lighthouse is made of paper or paper-like material, with a red and white striped design. The girl is wearing a pink backpack and has a pink ribbon around her neck.
photos.oracle_desc: Preteen girl with glasses and a pink headband standing outdoors on a sidewalk, holding a handmade model lighthouse with red and black stripes on a blue base. The lighthouse model is mounted on a gray painted board with a small label. She is wearing a pink top and has a backpack strap visible on her shoulder.

photos.oracle_desc: Child's clay or playdough sculpture on a table, consisting of a large brown mound base with small neon-colored figurines arranged on top. The figurines appear to be simple humanoid or creature shapes in bright yellow, pink, and green. The setting is a home or classroom interior.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a red raincoat stands in a field of tall, green grass, holding a white and blue blanket. She has blonde hair and is wearing a red raincoat with blue and white polka dots on the cuffs, blue jeans, and white shoes. Her face is pale and her eyes are closed, and she appears to be crying or upset.
photos.oracle_desc: Toddler girl in a red raincoat standing alone in a large open grass field, holding a stuffed toy or doll in front of her. The image has a faded, overexposed color tone giving the grass a pale green hue. The girl has blonde hair and is looking toward the camera with a neutral expression.

photos.llama_desc: A man in a black t-shirt, a man in a white shirt, and a man in a blue t-shirt pose for a photo together. The man in the white shirt is wearing a cowboy hat. The three men are standing in a tent-like structure with a white fabric roof.
photos.oracle_desc: Four men posing together under a large white tent canopy at what appears to be an outdoor festival or event, all smiling and facing the camera. One man in the center wears a straw cowboy hat and a western-style shirt. Tables, chairs, and other patrons are visible in the background.

photos.llama_desc: A young girl in a red and white soccer jersey, covered in mud, lies on her back in a grassy field. She has blonde hair and is wearing a red and white soccer jersey with the number 13 on the back. Her face is dirty and her hair is matted with mud.
photos.oracle_desc: Young girl in a mud-covered red soccer jersey with the number 13 standing upright on a grassy field, looking toward the camera. Her legs and uniform are heavily coated in mud. Other players and spectators are visible in the blurred background.

photos.llama_desc: A person's fingers are holding a yellow Stanley tape measure against a metal object with a rough, weathered surface. The object's surface is covered in a layer of dirt and has a few cracks and creases. The person's fingers are holding the tape measure at an angle, with the 4-inch mark on the tape measure aligned with the object's surface.
photos.oracle_desc: Close-up of a thumb pressing a yellow Stanley tape measure flat against a weathered, peeling metal surface to measure a gap or edge. The tape reads in the range of roughly 2 to 4 inches. The metal surface shows significant wear, oxidation, and debris.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a white dress, holding a bouquet of flowers, standing on a concrete path with a grassy area behind her. She is wearing a white dress with a low neckline and a short skirt, and her long hair is tied back. She is holding a small bouquet of flowers in her left hand.
photos.oracle_desc: Young woman in a floor-length silver or pale sparkly formal gown standing on outdoor stone steps, wearing a wrist corsage and strappy heeled sandals. Her long wavy blonde hair is worn down and she is smiling over her shoulder toward the camera. A police car and other dressed-up people are visible in the background, suggesting a prom setting.

photos.llama_desc: A blue and gold star-shaped object with a large, round, white and gold star-shaped object behind it, both against a blue sky. The object in the foreground has a blue, star-shaped body with a gold star on each side, and a gold star-shaped object behind it has a white and gold star pattern. The object in the background is a large, round, white and gold star-shaped object with a white and gold star pattern.
photos.oracle_desc: Large blue sorcerer's hat with gold stars photographed from below against a bright sky, the iconic Sorcerer's Hat landmark formerly at Disney's Hollywood Studios. A decorative archway or entrance structure is partially visible to the right. The hat dominates the frame with its tall pointed silhouette.

photos.llama_desc: A red pickup truck is parked in front of a house with a brown fence and a white house next to it. The house has a brown roof and a chimney. The red truck is parked on a grassy area with a few trees and a white house in the background.
photos.oracle_desc: Roadside scene shot from a moving vehicle showing a wide suburban street with a grassy median, a brick ranch house behind a brick wall or fence, and a red vehicle parked in the distance on the property. Trees are visible along the horizon against a blue sky. The vantage point and motion suggest this was taken from a passing car.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a white graduation gown and cap, with a gold and white sash around her neck, smiling at the camera. She has long, straight brown hair and is wearing a white cap with a gold and white sash around her neck. The sash has a gold and white patterned design.
photos.oracle_desc: Young woman in a white graduation cap and gown smiling broadly at the camera, photographed outdoors with green foliage behind her. She has long straight brown hair and wears a multi-colored honor stole and an orange or gold honor cord. The photo is a close-up portrait taken from a slightly low angle.

photos.llama_desc: A wicker basket with a large green leafy plant and a carved orange bear inside. The bear is made of a block of orange food, likely a block of cheese or a block of orange-colored food. The bear is carved to look like a bear, with a face, ears, and a body.
photos.oracle_desc: Display featuring a large orange bear figurine or sculpture sitting inside a wide wicker basket, surrounded by green leafy vegetables and other produce or decorative items. The photo is rotated sideways. The setting appears to be a restaurant or market with colorful decor visible in the background.
